name: Chthonic-Strath
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a tidally locked hemisphere, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
the buried megastructure still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on biomass and fusion fuel are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
